harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app on node1 to rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily, keep 7 compressed rotations, and use copytruncate so the application can keep writing to the same file path after rotation. Verified rotation, compression, and continued writes via a forced rotation, then restarted node1 and confirmed the config, timer, and log data survived with a changed boot identity.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 log file, existing logrotate setup, and installed logrotate version
Wrote /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app with daily, rotate 7, compress, missingok, notifempty, copytruncate, dateext
Validated config syntax with logrotate -d dry run
Forced a rotation with logrotate -f -v and verified app.log was rotated, compressed (.gz), and truncated while a new write succeeded afterward
Verified compressed rotated file content integrity with zcat
Captured baseline boot_id and health on node1
Issued sudo systemctl reboot on node1 (non-blocking) and polled until exec was available again
Confirmed changed boot_id post-restart and re-verified logrotate config, timer status, log data integrity, and continued write capability

evidence.requirement: Daily rotation with 7 compressed rotations kept, app keeps writing after rotation (functional requirement)
evidence.summary: Created inventory-app logrotate config (daily, rotate 7, compress, copytruncate); forced rotation produced app.log-20260929.gz containing prior content while app.log was truncated and a subsequent write ('app-continues-writing-...') succeeded, proving compressed rotation and uninterrupted writability

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol for node1: healthy baseline captured
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (67f3a44b-85c6-40fe-8529-fcb6e8ac337a), logrotate dry-run validity, log file state, and active logrotate.timer before restart

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol for node1: restart acknowledgement and reconnection
evidence.summary: Issued sudo systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), observed connection drop, then polled until exec succeeded again

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart protocol for node1: changed boot identity and recovered state
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id changed to bc1cbebf-405c-403c-a2f1-87b767e16ff3 (differs from baseline); logrotate.timer active, config file intact, rotated .gz content intact, and a new post-restart write appended successfully, confirming full recovery
